command:
pwd; echo '--- cwd ---'; ls -la; echo '--- /app ---'; ls -la /app 2>/dev/null || true; echo '--- python ---'; python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
print(sys.version)
try:
    import numpy as np
    print('numpy', np.__version__)
except Exception as e:
    print('numpy import failed:', repr(e))
try:
    import scipy
    print('scipy', scipy.__version__)
except Exception as e:
    print('scipy import failed:', repr(e))
PY
